newsitem.title: USA: Newell to expand domestically, abroad.
newsitem.headline: Newell to expand domestically, abroad.

text.p: Newell Co said Tuesday it is planning to expand its international business and will continue to grow domestically, including through acquisitions.

"We intend to increase our presence internationally, and we will continue to grow at home through acquisitions, new products, new customers and new channels of distribution," William Sovey, Newell's vice chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.
"We will take advantage of these many opportunities to provide an above-average return to our stockholders," he said.

Newell, which manufactures and markets housewares, hardware and other consumer products, reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.51 a share versus $0.42. Earnings for the year were $1.62 a share compared with $1.41.

The company said its financial goals are to achieve, on average, a 15 percent increase in earnings per share and a 20 percent or better return on beginning equity, while maintaining a prudent degree of leverage.
Newell's total debt to total capitalization was 34 percent at December 31, the company said.
